entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Sure, the name is Mark Rivera, and the order number is VF789-012.

Thank you, Mark. I see your order here for the Apex Racing Jersey, delivered on January 20th. That's well within our 90-day return window. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered my usual size, but this particular jersey is just too tight across the shoulders. It seems to be the wrong size for my build.
I understand completely. Our racing fits can be quite specific. So, you're looking for an exchange for a larger size, or would you prefer a full refund?
I'd like to do an exchange for one size up. The jersey itself is great, just the fit is off.

Excellent. I can process that for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid return label. Just pack the jersey back up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the new size immediately.

Okay, that sounds straightforward. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of packaging this up and driving to the post office, is there any way you could offer a small discount code for my trouble? Maybe 10% off my next order?

I appreciate you asking, Mark. While I understand it's an extra step for you, our policy covers the cost of the exchange and shipping, but we don't provide additional credits for sizing issues. It's considered a standard part of the process to ensure you get the perfect fit.
I get that, but it's still an inconvenience. Even a $10 credit would be a nice gesture for a loyal customer.

I truly wish I could, but my system is strict on this. Goodwill credits are reserved for situations where VeloFit made an error, like a shipping delay or a website fault. Since this is a preference-based exchange, the best I can do is make the process as fast and seamless as possible for you. The return label is on its way to your email now.
Alright, fair enough. I had to try. Thanks for getting the exchange process started for me.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you, Sarah.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
